messages:
jon: noticed invoice preview is ~23% higher for a handful of tenants after yesterday's routing-policy rollout. digging into the preview SQL doesn't match raw token counts. anyone else seeing this?

maya: yup saw the same spike in the console. routes/api-v2 shows more tokens attributed vs raw events. i thought the routing change only affects fallback priority, not attribution. :thinking_face:

luis: quick suspicion — route_tag might be getting stripped by the proxy when we fallback to the secondary model. that would cause events to land with empty route_id and then be reattributed by aggregation heuristics.

jon: could be. i grep'd the proto logs and found entries where request.meta.route_tag is missing during a 502->fallback path. snippet from edge proxy log: ```json
{"req_id":"r123","route_tag":null,"proxy_path":"/v1/generate","backend":"model-gpu-2","fallback_used":true}
```

olivia: if route_tag is null we currently map it to "unrouted" in the metering pipeline and then later the invoice-preview joins on session fingerprints which can pull a different route at finalize. double-count risk.

maya: confirmed in preview query: invoice_preview.events_joined_by_fingerprint is joining on session_id and picking the later final route if present. so a single user can show two events: one unrouted token + later routed token. preview counts both.

luis: root cause seems to be proxy not forwarding X-Route-Tag header into the internal request context when fallback is activated. i can reproduce locally with curl -> cause is a code path in route_decider.go: ```go
if resp.status >= 500 { // fallback path
    // we re-create request and forgot to copy headers here
    newReq.Headers = make(http.Header)
    newReq.Headers.Set("Authorization", orig.Headers.Get("Authorization"))
    // missing: copy X-Route-Tag
}
```

jon: ouch. small diff but big downstream. what's the easiest fix? backfill or patch?

olivia: short term: tweak invoice preview to dedupe by request fingerprint + time window so unrouted entries don't double-count if a final routed event exists within 1m. medium term: patch proxy to preserve route header and redeploy. long term: add route_tag as a required field on the metering event to prevent nulls.

maya: agree. for immediate customer-facing correctness we should update preview logic. i'll open a quick PR to apply a 60s de-dup window and exclude "unrouted" when a routed event exists.

luis: i'll send the proxy patch. small patch + unit test. will run canary on staging.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started for proxy v2.14.3 -> 2 instances (staging).

jon: also we should schedule a backfill to correct invoices for affected tenants. metering-bot, can you produce list of tenants with >5% preview vs finalized delta in the 24h window after the rollout?

metering-bot: generating report... will post a CSV in #eng-platform in ~10m. filters: timeframe=2026-03-18T00:00Z..2026-03-19T00:00Z, delta_threshold=5%.

olivia: note: before doing any invoice adjustments, we need to confirm finalize (billing) didn't already dedupe later. previews are best-effort. if finalize already fixed it we shouldn't change invoices.

jon: good call. action items: maya=PR for preview dedupe (hotfix), luis=proxy patch & canary, olivia=confirm finalize behavior + gate for invoice adjustments, jon=coordinating comms and RACI.

maya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4828 (hotfix). tests included.

luis: proxy PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/edge-proxy/pull/299 (copy headers on fallback). unit + integration tests added. will promote to canary tomorrow morning if staging looks good.

jon: thanks all. after canary, let's validate preview vs finalize for a few tenants before closing the thread.

olivia: also logging follow-up: add a metric for "metering.event.route_tag_missing" so we can alert if this spikes post-deploy. small instrumenting task.

metering-bot: report posted: /files/metering_delta_2026-03-18.csv (6 tenants above 5%, peak 27%).

jon: perfect. i'll loop in finance if we end up needing credits. closing loop once canary + finalize checks pass. :thumbsup:
